semiconductor_relevance: High — Yueda Technology specializes in high-quality electronic specialty gases and precursors essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Yueda Technology provides high-quality electronic specialty gases and precursor products tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include silicon-based specialty gases and metal-based precursors, supporting critical processes like CVD and ALD.
capabilities: Customized metal-based/silicon-based precursors for semiconductor processes
technical_expertise: Gas handling and safety protocols for silane operations

regional_presence.China: Yueda Technology operates a significant production base in Shaanxi, with a large-scale silane production line and a strong domestic market share.
